run_encode_densepose_results: run the script to encode DensePose estimation results from a pickle file into a packed JSON format using PNG compression
encode_png_data: encode a 3D uint8 numpy array of shape (3, M, N) into a base64-encoded PNG-compressed string
save_png_json: load pickle results, encode UV data as PNG, and save the packed results to a JSON file
parse_arguments: parse command-line arguments for the input pickle results file and output JSON packed file paths
status_str: generate a progress bar string showing completion percentage for encoding DensePose results
